hypotheses.justification: Split on 0 < r, using the existing proof in the positive case. Otherwise, Metric.nonneg_of_mem_closedBall hx gives 0 ≤ r, hence r = 0. By Metric.closedBall_zero, hx and hy then force x = c and y = c, so the conclusion simplifies to 0 ≤ 0 (with M / 0 = 0). Negative radii are impossible by hx. This also covers empty ι and trivial F.
